feature.title: WebSocket の認証・対局操作・資源制限
flow: Upgrade validates exact browser Origin/Host, optional same-site metadata and one supported shogi.realtime.v1 offer, then checks the session cookie with the user service and game access with GameService.

The reader validates strict move/resign JSON and canonical decimal sequence; one in-flight permit and bounded queues limit command work. The gateway supplies the authenticated user to the upstream command.
The command worker and writer recheck session/access before actions and outgoing frames; acceptance/errors become stable browser frames and uncertain outcomes require exact retry.
Connection/user permits, input byte/rate limits, snapshot/buffer bounds and timed upstream/output operations constrain connection work. Gateway shutdown rejects upgrades and closes active sockets.

guarantees.statement: Upgrade requires exact Origin/Host, optional same-origin fetch metadata, exactly one supported subprotocol offer and one valid session cookie. Session authentication and game access precede upgrade.

Only strict move/resign commands are accepted; no caller user/side claim is accepted. expected_seq is a canonical decimal string through i64::MAX and the gateway supplies authenticated identity. Accepted and rejected commands use stable response codes; uncertain outcomes become outcome_unknown.
Session and game access are rechecked before command dispatch and each outgoing frame. Logout/expiry or privacy loss closes the connection before further permitted delivery.
Total and per-user connections, input frame/message bytes/rate, one in-flight command, bounded notification/output queues, snapshot size and upstream/output deadlines constrain connection work.
Gateway shutdown prevents new upgrades and closes existing connections, including shutdown before the first connection. Capacity is released after disconnect.

contracts.statement: browser_headers requires one exact Origin and Host, permits absent fetch-site or same-origin only and finds exactly one supported shogi.realtime.v1 offer.

evidence.reason: Missing/evil/duplicate Origin, cross-site metadata and absent/wrong protocol reject with 403.

contracts.gap: Not every Host, duplicate protocol and header normalization combination is explicitly asserted by this selected test.

contracts.statement: AuthClient requires one correctly shaped cookie, calls the user service with response size/time limits and recheck requires the returned user to remain the session user.

source.needle: pub(crate) async fn authenticate(&self, cookie: &str) -> Result<UserId, AuthError> {

evidence.reason: Missing/duplicate/invalid/unknown session cookies reject upgrade with 401.
Actual logout before a command and expiry before a notification close sockets; subsequent upgrades are 401.

contracts.gap: No dedicated assertion covers auth service outage/redirect/oversized profile, returned user mismatch or every cookie encoding branch.

contracts.statement: Upgrade authenticates/access-checks, checks shutdown before/after upstream calls, acquires total and per-user permits and configures frame/message limits; disconnect Drop releases capacity.

evidence.reason: Total two/per-user one rejects excess with 429, and reconnect succeeds after disconnect.
Private outsider and absent game yield indistinguishable 404 upgrade status/body.
Oversized frames close without committing.
Shutdown before any connection makes first upgrade 503.

contracts.gap: No dedicated race assertion covers shutdown during an upstream handshake. Capacity tests do not exhaust every in-flight handshake state.

contracts.statement: The reader enforces frame/rate limits, strict command parsing, one in-flight command permit and a bounded queue. Parser rejects unknown fields and noncanonical decimal sequences/USI.

evidence.reason: Forged user_id returns invalid_input with sequence still zero; spectator move/resign return not_participant.
Input byte limit 128 and rate one terminate abusive sockets while durable sequence remains zero.
Valid participant move and resign commands dispatch and return matching acceptance.

contracts.gap: No parser table enumerates malformed decimal strings, oversized numeric values or all unknown fields. No dedicated busy/in-flight permit or command queue/output-overflow assertion.

contracts.statement: command_reply maps acceptance and gRPC codes to accepted, invalid_input, not_participant, request_conflict, stale_seq/actual_seq, rejected or outcome_unknown; inaccessible/corrupt/internal upstream outcomes close.

source.needle: pub(crate) fn command_reply(id: &str, result: Result<proto::Acceptance, Status>) -> CommandOutcome {

evidence.reason: Accepted request identity and sequence match participant commands.
Outsider move/resign produce not_participant.
Retry after reconnect returns original accepted sequence without duplicate event.

contracts.gap: No selected gateway test directly asserts stale_seq metadata, request_conflict, rejected, outcome_unknown or all upstream status/invalid-result close mappings.

contracts.statement: command_worker rechecks session and current game access before invoking upstream command using session.user.

evidence.reason: Logout before sending move closes and leaves durable sequence zero.
Spectator cannot mutate or supply a participant identity.

contracts.gap: No independent recheck-before-response race assertion or timed upstream mutation outcome test.

contracts.statement: writer rechecks session/access before every frame and bounds send/close waits; bootstrap rejects a snapshot exceeding configured bytes and uses bounded output/notification channels.

evidence.reason: Expired viewer closes before published resignation delivery.
Privacy revoked for existing spectator closes on the next event.
Snapshot bytes limit one closes without sending a partial position.

contracts.gap: No slow-browser backlog, output write deadline, exhausted notification queue or snapshot upstream-timeout assertion. Snapshot limit is enforced in run_connection, which this evidence exercises.

contracts.statement: shutdown stores a persistent stop signal; active connections watch it and upgrade refuses new work. wait_closed bounds waiting for all total permits.

evidence.reason: Active socket closes and later upgrade returns 503.
The first upgrade after shutdown is rejected 503.

contracts.gap: Tests exercise router/library shutdown, not actual executable Ctrl-C, configuration validation or its ten-second drain deadline; wait_closed deadline exhaustion is not separately asserted.

limitations: The gateway authenticates browser identity; the upstream trusted gRPC service itself accepts claims. Session/access checks bound disclosure at checked operations, not a globally atomic cross-service authorization snapshot.

Resource bounds cover configured queues/permits and deadlines; selected tests do not prove every overload or timeout branch. There is no separate handshake/input semaphore beyond the implemented connection and in-flight command permits.
Executable startup/configuration/signal behavior is owned by the runtime feature record and is not established by these library router tests.
Links and passing tests do not establish semantic completeness; changes to guarantees, evidence strength and decomposition require review.
